name: The Beasts of Turnsol, de Leonor Martins
description: This exhibition presents works by emerging artist Leonor Martins combining contemporary digital art techniques, including 3D modelling and Procreate.
longDescription:
The Beasts of Turnsol is an art exhibition by emerging artist Leonor Martins. The works bring together contemporary digital art techniques, using 3D modelling alongside Procreate.

The event takes place at Escola Normal (Casa Cultural), located at Rua de Guerra Junqueiro, 511. Doors open at 16:30 on 21 November 2026, with tickets priced at 3€.
